methods.name: Ordered logit (proportional odds), MASS::polr parameterisation
methods.reference: MASS::polr(method = 'logistic', control = list(reltol = 1e-15)) polished to the exact MLE; observed-information SEs (analytic Hessian = numDeriv::hessian)
methods.tolerance: MLE (validation/README.md, iterative): coefficients and cut points 1e-6, SEs and z 1e-5 relative; p 2e-3 relative (z^2 times the z tolerance); log-likelihood, AIC, BIC, pseudo-R2 1e-6 (n = 400); counts exact; MCP text at print precision (4 decimals)

methods.name: Ordered probit, MASS::polr parameterisation
methods.reference: MASS::polr(method = 'probit', control = list(reltol = 1e-15)) polished to the exact MLE; observed-information SEs

methods.name: Negative binomial regression (NB2, log link), MASS::glm.nb
methods.reference: MASS::glm.nb(control = glm.control(epsilon = 1e-14)) polished to the joint (beta, theta) MLE; beta SEs (X'WX)^-1 as summary.negbin; SE(theta) = 1/sqrt(theta.ml information) at the optimum; base R trigamma
methods.tolerance: MLE: coefficients and theta 1e-6, SEs and z 1e-5 relative; p 2e-3 relative; log-likelihood, AIC, BIC 1e-6 (n = 400); mean/variance of y 1e-8; glm.nb's own SE.theta 1e-4 (evaluated one theta.ml step before its theta); trigamma 1e-12 relative

deviations.note: not pinned: the null log-likelihood omits the lnGamma terms and reuses the full model's theta (Tier 4)
